phrase.zh: 三好微電影國際創作競賽
phrase.en: Three Acts of Goodness International Microfilm Contest

sentences.zh: 在今年的三好微電影國際創作競賽中，來自世界各地的創作者帶來了無數感人的故事。
sentences.en: In this year's Three Acts of Goodness International Microfilm Contest, creators from all over the world brought countless touching stories.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會會長表示，三好微電影國際創作競賽是一個鼓勵年輕人發揮創意的平台。
sentences.en: The President of BLIA stated that the Three Acts of Goodness International Microfilm Contest is a platform encouraging young people to express their creativity.

sentences.zh: 理事會將舉辦三好微電影國際創作競賽的頒獎典禮，以表彰優秀的作品和創作者。
sentences.en: The Board of Directors will host the award ceremony for the Three Acts of Goodness International Microfilm Contest to recognize outstanding works and creators.

sentences.zh: 她因在三好微電影國際創作競賽中獲得最佳導演獎而備受讚譽。
sentences.en: She was highly praised for winning the Best Director award at the Three Acts of Goodness International Microfilm Contest.

sentences.zh: 今年的世界佛光童軍大會將於夏季在台灣舉行，吸引了來自全球的青年童軍參加。
sentences.en: This year's World BLIA Scout Jamboree will be held in Taiwan during the summer, attracting young scouts from around the globe.

sentences.zh: 世界佛光童軍大會提供了一個平台，讓青年可以學習交流，並增強他們的領導能力。
sentences.en: The World BLIA Scout Jamboree provides a platform for youths to learn, exchange ideas, and enhance their leadership skills.

sentences.zh: 在世界佛光童軍大會期間，參加者將有機會參與各種戶外活動和文化交流。
sentences.en: During the World BLIA Scout Jamboree, participants will have the opportunity to engage in various outdoor activities and cultural exchanges.

sentences.zh: 世界佛光童軍大會的開幕式由國際佛光會會長主持，儀式隆重且充滿活力。
sentences.en: The opening ceremony of the World BLIA Scout Jamboree was presided over by the president of the BLIA, with a ceremony that was solemn and vibrant.

phrase.en: International Buddha’s Light Young Adult Conference

sentences.zh: 今年的世界佛光青年大會將在台灣舉行，吸引了來自世界各地的青年參加。
sentences.en: This year's International Buddha’s Light Young Adult Conference will be held in Taiwan, attracting young participants from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 李會長在世界佛光青年大會上發表了有關環保的重要演講。
sentences.en: President Lee delivered an important speech on environmental protection at the International Buddha’s Light Young Adult Conference.

sentences.zh: 參加世界佛光青年大會的代表們交換了有關社會服務的想法和經驗。
sentences.en: Delegates at the International Buddha’s Light Young Adult Conference exchanged ideas and experiences regarding social services.

sentences.zh: 世界佛光青年大會旨在鼓勵青年參與佛教與社會事務的融合。
sentences.en: The International Buddha’s Light Young Adult Conference aims to encourage young people to integrate Buddhism with social affairs.

phrase.en: World Conference of Outstanding Buddhist Women

sentences.zh: 在世界傑出婦女會議上，她分享了她的環保倡議，並獲得了與會者的熱烈迴響。
sentences.en: At the World Conference of Outstanding Buddhist Women, she shared her environmental initiatives and received enthusiastic feedback from the participants.

sentences.zh: 這次的世界傑出婦女會議吸引了來自世界各地的領袖，以探索促進性別平等的策略。
sentences.en: The World Conference of Outstanding Buddhist Women attracted leaders from around the globe to explore strategies for promoting gender equality.

sentences.zh: 她在世界傑出婦女會議中發表了關於女性領導力在佛教界的重要性的研究報告。
sentences.en: She presented a research paper on the importance of female leadership in the Buddhist community at the World Conference of Outstanding Buddhist Women.

sentences.zh: 世界傑出婦女會議提供了一個平台，讓與會者能夠交流成功經驗與面臨的挑戰。
sentences.en: The World Conference of Outstanding Buddhist Women provided a platform for participants to exchange success stories and challenges faced.

phrase.zh: 中華佛光青年團員大會

sentences.zh: 今年的中華佛光青年團員大會將在台北舉行，預計有上百位青年參加。
sentences.en: This year's BLIA-YAD Chunghua General Conference will be held in Taipei, with hundreds of youths expected to attend.

sentences.zh: 中華佛光青年團員大會主要目標是促進青年人的宗教交流和文化認識。
sentences.en: The main goal of the BLIA-YAD Chunghua General Conference is to promote religious exchange and cultural awareness among the youth.

sentences.zh: 李會長在中華佛光青年團員大會上強調青年在推動佛教文化中的重要性。
sentences.en: President Lee emphasized the importance of youth in promoting Buddhist culture at the BLIA-YAD Chunghua General Conference.

sentences.zh: 在中華佛光青年團員大會的閉幕式上，青年們用音樂和舞蹈展示了他們的創意和熱情。
sentences.en: At the closing ceremony of the BLIA-YAD Chunghua General Conference, the youths showcased their creativity and enthusiasm through music and dance.

sentences.zh: 今年的人間佛教唱歌比賽吸引了來自世界各地的參賽者。
sentences.en: This year's Humanistic Buddhism Singing Contest attracted participants from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會長親自為人間佛教唱歌比賽的獲獎者頒獎。
sentences.en: The president of BLIA personally awarded the winners of the Humanistic Buddhism Singing Contest.

sentences.zh: 參加人間佛教唱歌比賽是一個讓大家理解佛教文化的好機會。
sentences.en: Participating in the Humanistic Buddhism Singing Contest is a great opportunity for everyone to understand Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 理事會正在籌備明年的人間佛教唱歌比賽，希望能吸引更多青年參與。
sentences.en: The council is organizing next year's Humanistic Buddhism Singing Contest and hopes to attract more youth participation.

sentences.zh: 作為國際佛光會的人間佛教宣講員，他致力於向大眾傳播佛教教義。
sentences.en: As a Humanistic Buddhism Speaker for BLIA, he is dedicated to spreading Buddhist teachings to the public.

sentences.zh: 這位人間佛教宣講員的講座深受學生們的歡迎，大家都讚賞他的智慧和見解。
sentences.en: The lecture by the Humanistic Buddhism Speaker was well received by students, who praised his wisdom and insights.

sentences.zh: 她是一位經驗豐富的人間佛教宣講員，參與了許多國際性的佛教論壇。
sentences.en: She is an experienced Humanistic Buddhism Speaker who has participated in numerous international Buddhist forums.

sentences.zh: 人間佛教宣講員們的使命是促進心靈成長和社會和諧。
sentences.en: The mission of Humanistic Buddhism Speakers is to promote spiritual growth and social harmony.

sentences.zh: 張先生剛剛完成了人間佛教宣講員培訓，現在準備在國際佛光會各分會中進行演講。
sentences.en: Mr. Zhang has just completed the Humanistic Buddhism Speakers Online Training and is now preparing to give talks at various BLIA chapters.

sentences.zh: 人間佛教宣講員培訓課程旨在培養更多具備靈活宣講技能的志工，助力全球推廣人間佛教。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhism Speakers Online Training course aims to cultivate more volunteers with adaptable speaking skills to support the global promotion of Humanistic Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 參加人間佛教宣講員培訓的學員來自世界各地，透過線上課程，學習到如何有效地傳播佛法。
sentences.en: Participants in the Humanistic Buddhism Speakers Online Training come from around the world, learning through online courses how to effectively disseminate Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的理事長強調，人間佛教宣講員培訓對於提升志工的宣講能力具有重要意義。
sentences.en: The BLIA president emphasized that the Humanistic Buddhism Speakers Online Training is significant in improving the speaking abilities of volunteers.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的理事會為會長組織了一場人間佛教宣講示範，以提升他的宣講技巧。
sentences.en: The BLIA's council organized a Humanistic Buddhism Speaker Training for the chairman to enhance his speaking skills.

sentences.zh: 她在參加人間佛教宣講示範後，對於如何將佛教理念融入日常生活有了更深的理解。
sentences.en: After participating in the Humanistic Buddhism Speaker Training, she gained a deeper understanding of how to integrate Buddhist principles into daily life.

sentences.zh: 行政文書組的成員們參加了這次人間佛教宣講示範，提升了他們的溝通能力。
sentences.en: Members of the BLIA's administrative document department attended the Humanistic Buddhism Speaker Training, improving their communication skills.

sentences.zh: 這場人間佛教宣講示範吸引了眾多會員參加，所有人都期待著學習新知識。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhism Speaker Training attracted many members who were eager to learn new insights.

sentences.zh: 本週末的人間佛教研習會將討論如何在現代生活中應用佛教教義。
sentences.en: This weekend's Seminar on Humanistic Buddhism will discuss how to apply Buddhist teachings in modern life.

sentences.zh: 我參加了由國際佛光會主辦的人間佛教研習會，受益良多。
sentences.en: I attended the Seminar on Humanistic Buddhism organized by the BLIA and gained a lot of insights.

sentences.zh: 人間佛教研習會吸引了許多全球學者和佛學愛好者的參與。
sentences.en: The Seminar on Humanistic Buddhism attracted many scholars and enthusiasts from around the world.

sentences.zh: 在那次人間佛教研習會上，我們探討了人間佛教的起源及其發展。
sentences.en: At the Seminar on Humanistic Buddhism, we explored the origins and development of Humanistic Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 人間佛教讀書會初階帶領人培訓
phrase.en: Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Leadership Training for Beginners

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會為新人提供了一個人間佛教讀書會初階帶領人培訓，以提升他們的領導能力。
sentences.en: BLIA offered a Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Leadership Training for Beginners to enhance their leadership skills.

sentences.zh: 參加這個人間佛教讀書會初階帶領人培訓的學員們，對未來的讀書會活動充滿了熱情與期待。
sentences.en: The participants of the Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Leadership Training for Beginners were filled with enthusiasm and anticipation for future reading group activities.

sentences.zh: 在完成了人間佛教讀書會初階帶領人培訓後，他獲得了主持讀書會的信心。
sentences.en: After completing the Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Leadership Training for Beginners, he gained the confidence to lead the reading group.

sentences.zh: 此人間佛教讀書會初階帶領人培訓同時強調了人間佛教的理論與實踐。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Leadership Training for Beginners also emphasized the theory and practice of Humanistic Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會長強調佛教教義在人間與生活中的重要性。
sentences.en: The president of BLIA emphasized the importance of Buddhist teachings in the human world and life.

sentences.zh: 她在演講中探討了如何在日常生活中結合人間與生活的智慧。
sentences.en: In her speech, she explored how to integrate the wisdom of the human world and life into daily living.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的理事會決定每年舉辦一次大會，討論人間與生活的不同議題。
sentences.en: The board of directors at BLIA decided to hold an annual conference to discuss various topics regarding the human world and life.

sentences.zh: 這本書提供了關於理解人間與生活的深入見解，對讀者非常有啟發。
sentences.en: This book offers profound insights into understanding the human world and life, proving to be very inspiring for readers.

sentences.zh: 佛光之夜是國際佛光會一年一度的重要慶典，吸引了來自各地的信徒聚集於此。
sentences.en: The Night of the Buddha’s Light is an annual major celebration for BLIA, attracting devotees from various places to gather together.

sentences.zh: 在這次佛光之夜，我們欣賞到了來自世界各地的精彩文化表演。
sentences.en: During this Night of the Buddha’s Light, we enjoyed amazing cultural performances from around the world.

sentences.zh: 佛光之夜的燈會充滿著祥和與喜悅，象徵著佛法的智慧照亮每一個角落。
sentences.en: The lantern festival during the Night of the Buddha’s Light is filled with peace and joy, symbolizing the wisdom of the Dharma illuminating every corner.

sentences.zh: 她被任命為今年佛光之夜的籌備委員會負責人，確保活動的成功舉行。
sentences.en: She was appointed as the head of the organizing committee for this year’s Night of the Buddha’s Light, ensuring the event is successfully held.

phrase.en: Fo Guang member; Buddha’s Light member

sentences.zh: 作為佛光人，他們致力於推廣佛教文化，並促進社區和諧。
sentences.en: As Fo Guang members, they are dedicated to promoting Buddhist culture and fostering community harmony.

sentences.zh: 她成為佛光人已經十年，全心投入公益活動。
sentences.en: She has been a Buddha’s Light member for ten years, fully devoting herself to charity work.

sentences.zh: 佛光人群策群力，成功舉辦了年度國際佛光大會。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members collaborated successfully to host the annual International Buddha's Light Convention.

sentences.zh: 身為佛光人，他經常參加國際佛光會的各項活動，努力宣揚慈悲和智慧。
sentences.en: As a Buddha’s Light member, he frequently participates in BLIA activities, striving to promote compassion and wisdom.

phrase.en: Fo Guang (Buddha's Light as well) Baby Blessing Ceremony

sentences.zh: 他們邀請家人和朋友參加佛光寶寶祝福禮，共同見證寶寶的成長與祝福。
sentences.en: They invited family and friends to the Fo Guang Baby Blessing Ceremony to witness the baby's growth and blessings together.

sentences.zh: 在佛光寶寶祝福禮中，法師們為每位寶寶誦經祈福，希望他們一生幸福安康。
sentences.en: During the Fo Guang Baby Blessing Ceremony, monks chanted prayers for each baby, wishing them a life of happiness and well-being.

sentences.zh: 佛光寶寶祝福禮是一個傳統的儀式，充滿愛與祝福。
sentences.en: The Fo Guang Baby Blessing Ceremony is a traditional ritual filled with love and blessings.

sentences.zh: 今年的佛光寶寶祝福禮將在佛光山的主殿舉行，預計會有許多家庭參加。
sentences.en: This year's Fo Guang Baby Blessing Ceremony will be held at the main hall of Fo Guang Shan, with many families expected to attend.

phrase.zh: 佛光會幹部叢林生活營

sentences.zh: 佛光會幹部叢林生活營的目的是提升領導才能與團隊合作能力。
sentences.en: The BLIA Executive Training Seminar aims to enhance leadership skills and teamwork capabilities.

sentences.zh: 參加佛光會幹部叢林生活營的成員都表示受益良多，對未來的工作充滿信心。
sentences.en: Participants of the BLIA Executive Training Seminar expressed that they greatly benefited from it and are confident about their future tasks.

sentences.zh: 佛光會幹部叢林生活營提供了一個平台，讓幹部們相互學習，共同進步。
sentences.en: The BLIA Executive Training Seminar provides a platform for executives to learn from each other and advance together.

sentences.zh: 透過佛光會幹部叢林生活營，他們培養了堅毅不拔的精神和高效率的工作方式。
sentences.en: Through the BLIA Executive Training Seminar, they cultivated a spirit of perseverance and an efficient work style.

sentences.zh: 今年的佛光會督導研習營吸引了許多來自不同國家的資深會員參加。
sentences.en: This year's BLIA Elder Advisors Seminar attracted many veteran members from various countries.

sentences.zh: 在佛光會督導研習營中，學員們共同探討了如何增進國際佛光會的組織發展。
sentences.en: During the BLIA Elder Advisors Seminar, participants discussed ways to enhance the development of the BLIA organization.

sentences.zh: 佛光會主席在督導研習營上分享了他的願景，希望每一位督導都能成為佛光會的中流砥柱。
sentences.en: The BLIA President shared his vision at the Elder Advisors Seminar, hoping that each advisor could become a cornerstone of the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 這次的佛光會督導研習營包括了豐富的工作坊，讓督導們可以交流心得並增進彼此的理解。
sentences.en: The recent BLIA Elder Advisors Seminar included enriching workshops, allowing elder advisors to exchange insights and enhance mutual understanding.

phrase.zh: 佛光童軍服務員知能研習營

sentences.zh: 佛光童軍服務員知能研習營每年吸引了來自世界各地的參與者，共同學習與成長。
sentences.en: The Buddha’s Light Scouts Staff Seminar attracts participants from around the world each year for shared learning and growth.

sentences.zh: 在佛光童軍服務員知能研習營中，服務員們學習了新的技能，以提高他們在童軍活動中的貢獻。
sentences.en: At the Buddha’s Light Scouts Staff Seminar, staff members learn new skills to enhance their contributions to scouting activities.

sentences.zh: 佛光童軍服務員知能研習營的講座內容豐富，涵蓋了領導力、團隊協作及問題解決等重要主題。
sentences.en: The seminars at the Buddha’s Light Scouts Staff Seminar cover a wide range of topics, including leadership, teamwork, and problem-solving.

sentences.zh: 透過參加佛光童軍服務員知能研習營，參與者不僅增進了專業能力，還拓展了國際視野。
sentences.en: By attending the Buddha’s Light Scouts Staff Seminar, participants not only enhance their professional skills but also broaden their international perspectives.

phrase.zh: 佛光菩提眷屬慶祝賀禮
phrase.en: Fo Guang Bodhi Couple Vow Renewal Ceremony

sentences.zh: 每年，國際佛光會的佛光菩提眷屬慶祝賀禮吸引了許多信眾夫妻前來參加，以加強彼此的誓約。
sentences.en: Each year, the Fo Guang Bodhi Couple Vow Renewal Ceremony hosted by the BLIA attracts many Buddhist couples to reaffirm their vows.

sentences.zh: 參加佛光菩提眷屬慶祝賀禮的夫妻表示，這不僅是一個慶祝婚姻的機會，也是重新審視自己修行的時刻。
sentences.en: Couples participating in the Fo Guang Bodhi Couple Vow Renewal Ceremony express that it is not only an opportunity to celebrate their marriage but also a moment to reflect on their spiritual journey.

sentences.zh: 在佛光菩提眷屬慶祝賀禮上，會長致辭強調了信仰與家庭和諧的重要性。
sentences.en: During the Fo Guang Bodhi Couple Vow Renewal Ceremony, the BLIA President emphasized the importance of faith and family harmony in their speech.

sentences.zh: 這次佛光菩提眷屬慶祝賀禮的安排由行政文書組和理事會共同協助策劃，確保活動的圓滿成功。
sentences.en: The arrangement for this year’s Fo Guang Bodhi Couple Vow Renewal Ceremony was co-organized by the Administrative Secretariat and the Executive Council to ensure the event’s success.

phrase.en: Buddha’s Light Young Adult Executive Growth And Development Camp

sentences.zh: 今年的佛光青年幹部成長營吸引了來自全球的300名青年參加，大家在營中學習領導力與團隊合作。
sentences.en: This year's Buddha’s Light Young Adult Executive Growth And Development Camp attracted 300 young participants from around the world, where they learned leadership and teamwork.

sentences.zh: 作為佛光青年幹部成長營的一部分，參與者接受了如何在社區中推廣佛教理念的訓練。
sentences.en: As part of the Buddha’s Light Young Adult Executive Growth And Development Camp, participants received training on how to promote Buddhist principles within the community.

sentences.zh: 佛光青年幹部成長營的活動內容包括專題講座、心靈成長工作坊及慈善服務。
sentences.en: The Buddha’s Light Young Adult Executive Growth And Development Camp includes thematic lectures, personal growth workshops, and charitable service activities.

sentences.zh: 學員們在佛光青年幹部成長營中建立了深厚的友誼，這些關係將持續支持他們未來的佛教事業。
sentences.en: The attendees formed deep friendships at the Buddha’s Light Young Adult Executive Growth And Development Camp, relationships which will continue to support their future Buddhist endeavors.

sentences.zh: 在佛光青年成年禮上，年輕人們感受到成為成年人所肩負的責任與榮譽。
sentences.en: At the Fo Guang Adulthood Ceremony, the youth felt the weight of the responsibilities and honors that come with becoming an adult.

sentences.zh: 每年的佛光青年成年禮都引來眾多家庭前來，共同為年輕人的成長喝采。
sentences.en: Every year, the Fo Guang Adulthood Ceremony attracts numerous families who come together to celebrate the growth of the young adults.

sentences.zh: 李會長在佛光青年成年禮中致辭，鼓勵年輕人擁抱未來的挑戰。
sentences.en: President Lee delivered a speech at the Fo Guang Adulthood Ceremony, encouraging the youth to embrace the challenges of the future.

sentences.zh: 佛光青年成年禮強調佛教的核心價值觀，如慈悲與智慧，作為年輕人未來的指引。
sentences.en: The Fo Guang Adulthood Ceremony emphasizes core Buddhist values such as compassion and wisdom as guidance for the youth's future.

phrase.zh: 佛光青年白象幹部培訓

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會特設佛光青年白象幹部培訓項目，旨在培育未來的青年領袖。
sentences.en: The BLIA specially designed the BLIA-YAD White Elephant Training Workshop to cultivate future young leaders.

sentences.zh: 參加佛光青年白象幹部培訓的成員表示，他們學到了許多寶貴的技能和人際溝通技巧。
sentences.en: Participants in the BLIA-YAD White Elephant Training Workshop expressed that they learned many valuable skills and interpersonal communication techniques.

sentences.zh: 這次佛光青年白象幹部培訓成功地激發了學員的領導潛能。
sentences.en: This BLIA-YAD White Elephant Training Workshop successfully inspired the leadership potential of its participants.

sentences.zh: 佛光青年白象幹部培訓的講師都是來自各個領域的專家，為學員提供全面的指導。
sentences.en: The instructors of the BLIA-YAD White Elephant Training Workshop are experts from various fields, providing comprehensive guidance to the participants.

sentences.zh: 在佛光體系青年大會師上，青年志工們分享了他們在各地參與慈善活動的經驗。
sentences.en: At the Fo Guang Shan Youth Summit, young volunteers shared their experiences participating in charity activities across various regions.

sentences.zh: 今年的佛光體系青年大會師吸引了來自世界各地的青年，致力於推廣人間佛教的理念。
sentences.en: This year's Fo Guang Shan Youth Summit attracted youth from around the world, committed to promoting the ideals of Humanistic Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 會長在佛光體系青年大會師上勉勵與會者要以愛與智慧來面對全球的挑戰。
sentences.en: The president encouraged participants at the Fo Guang Shan Youth Summit to face global challenges with love and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛光體系青年大會師提供了一個國際平台，使青年能夠交流思想並建立友誼。
sentences.en: The Fo Guang Shan Youth Summit provided an international platform for young people to exchange ideas and build friendships.

sentences.zh: 每年佛誕浴佛法會上，信眾們以滿懷敬意的心情參加，為佛像以香湯淨浴。
sentences.en: Every year, during the Bathing the Buddha Celebration, devotees participate with great reverence, using fragrant water to purify the Buddha statue.

sentences.zh: 佛光會的主席強調，佛誕浴佛法會是弘揚佛教精神的重要活動，使大家心靈得到洗滌。
sentences.en: The BLIA Chairman emphasized that the Bathing the Buddha Celebration is a significant event for promoting Buddhist spirit, offering a chance for spiritual purification.

sentences.zh: 在佛光會的佛誕浴佛法會上，行政文書組籌備的活動讓參加者們深感動容。
sentences.en: During the Bathing the Buddha Celebration organized by BLIA, the activities prepared by the Documentation Division moved the participants deeply.

sentences.zh: 這個佛誕浴佛法會不僅吸引了本地的信眾，也有許多國際的佛教徒專程前來參與。
sentences.en: This Bathing the Buddha Celebration not only attracted local devotees but also many international Buddhists who came specifically to participate.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的成員相信信仰與傳承是維繫組織活力的重要基石。
sentences.en: Members of BLIA believe that faith and legacy are vital foundations for sustaining the vibrancy of the organization.

sentences.zh: 佛教理事會討論如何通過教育來促進信仰與傳承。
sentences.en: The Buddhist council discussed how to promote faith and legacy through education.

sentences.zh: 講座中強調了在現代社會保持信仰與傳承的重要性。
sentences.en: The lecture emphasized the importance of maintaining faith and legacy in modern society.

sentences.zh: 會長在年度大會上談到每一位成員對信仰與傳承的貢獻。
sentences.en: The president spoke at the annual conference about each member's contribution to faith and legacy.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的指導下，我們學會追求公是與公非，明辨是非，建立和諧社會。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of Buddhism, we learn to pursue one truth for all, discerning right from wrong, and building a harmonious society.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會議上，會長強調了公是與公非的重要性，以此來促進成員之間的良好溝通。
sentences.en: At the BLIA meeting, the president stressed the importance of one truth for all to promote good communication among members.

sentences.zh: 行政文書組致力於確保所有的決策都基於公是與公非，確保組織運作的公平與透明。
sentences.en: The administrative documentation unit is committed to ensuring that all decisions are based on one truth for all, guaranteeing fairness and transparency in the organization's operations.

sentences.zh: 我們的教育計劃著重於學生理解公是與公非，讓他們在未來能夠做出正確的選擇。
sentences.en: Our educational program focuses on helping students understand one truth for all, so that they can make the right choices in the future.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會(BLIA)的宗旨之一是促進不同文化之間的共生與共榮。
sentences.en: One of the missions of the Buddha's Light International Association (BLIA) is to promote coexistence and coprosperity among different cultures.

sentences.zh: 在環保議題上，共生與共榮的理念能夠促進永續發展。
sentences.en: On environmental issues, the concept of coexistence and coprosperity can promote sustainable development.

sentences.zh: 理事會強調共生與共榮的重要性，並呼籲會員推廣這一理念。
sentences.en: The council emphasized the importance of coexistence and coprosperity and urged members to promote this concept.

sentences.zh: 透過共同努力，我們可以實現社會的共生與共榮，讓每個人都能受益。
sentences.en: Through joint efforts, we can achieve social coexistence and coprosperity, benefiting everyone.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會的理事會會議上，成員們強調共識與開放的重要性，以促進組織的進一步發展。
sentences.en: During the BLIA council meeting, members emphasized the importance of consensus and openness to facilitate the organization's further development.

sentences.zh: 這個社區以共識與開放的精神運作，讓所有成員都有機會參與決策。
sentences.en: The community operates in the spirit of consensus and openness, ensuring all members have a chance to participate in decision-making.

sentences.zh: 他的領導風格充滿了共識與開放，這使得團隊能夠在具體目標下齊心協力。
sentences.en: His leadership style is characterized by consensus and openness, allowing the team to work cohesively towards specific goals.

sentences.zh: 共識與開放是佛教修行的重要部分，幫助修行者在和諧中追求智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: Consensus and openness are vital aspects of Buddhist practice, aiding practitioners in the harmonious pursuit of wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會副主任委員在年度大會中發表了重要演講，介紹了未來的計畫和目標。
sentences.en: The Deputy Executive Director of the BLIA delivered a significant speech at the annual conference, outlining future plans and objectives.

sentences.zh: 副主任委員負責協調各地分會，確保活動的順利進行並達成組織目標。
sentences.en: The Deputy Committee Director is responsible for coordinating regional branches, ensuring smooth execution of activities and achieving organizational goals.

sentences.zh: 這位國際佛光會的副主任委員，以他的領導才幹聞名，常常被邀請主持重要會議。
sentences.en: This BLIA Deputy Executive Director is renowned for his leadership skills and is often invited to chair important meetings.

sentences.zh: 作為副主任委員，他經常代表國際佛光會出席國際論壇，推廣佛教精神與價值。
sentences.en: As the Deputy Committee Director, he frequently represents the BLIA at international forums, promoting Buddhist values and spirit.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會的年度大會上，副會長發表了關於未來展望的精彩演講。
sentences.en: At the BLIA annual conference, the Vice President delivered an inspiring speech on the future outlook.

sentences.zh: 副會長協助會長策劃並主持了當前的會議，確保議程順利進行。
sentences.en: The Vice President assisted the President in planning and chairing the current meeting, ensuring the agenda proceeded smoothly.

sentences.zh: 作為副會長，她負責監督多個委員會的工作，以達成組織的各項目標。
sentences.en: As the Vice President, she is responsible for overseeing various committees to achieve the organization's goals.

sentences.zh: 新的副會長將會在下週的理事會會議上宣誓就職。
sentences.en: The new Vice President will be sworn in at the council meeting next week.

phrase.en: Change the World and Benefit Humanity

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會會長以化世與益人的精神領導會務，推動全球和平對話。
sentences.en: The president of the BLIA leads the organization with the spirit to change the world and benefit humanity, promoting global peace dialogues.

sentences.zh: 她加入國際佛光會志工團隊，致力於化世與益人的使命，並服務社區。
sentences.en: She joined the BLIA volunteer team, dedicating herself to the mission to change the world and benefit humanity, and serving the community.

sentences.zh: 我們的慈善活動旨在化世與益人，為貧困地區提供教育資源。
sentences.en: Our charitable activities aim to change the world and benefit humanity by providing educational resources to impoverished areas.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會的會議中，討論了如何以化世與益人之心來應對環境挑戰。
sentences.en: In the BLIA's conference, discussions were made on how to address environmental challenges with a mindset to change the world and benefit humanity.

phrase.en: BLIA North America Online Fellowship Meeting

sentences.zh: 在北美洲線上聯誼會上，會長分享了國際佛光會的最新發展。
sentences.en: During the BLIA North America Online Fellowship Meeting, the president shared the latest developments of the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 北美洲線上聯誼會為成員提供了一個交流心得和增進修行的平臺。
sentences.en: The BLIA North America Online Fellowship Meeting provided members with a platform to share insights and enhance their practice.

sentences.zh: 由於疫情的影響，年度北美洲線上聯誼會都改在線上舉行。
sentences.en: Due to the pandemic, the annual BLIA North America Online Fellowship Meeting was held online.

sentences.zh: 北美洲線上聯誼會吸引了來自不同地區的佛光成員參加，共同探討佛法。
sentences.en: The BLIA North America Online Fellowship Meeting attracted Fo Guang members from different regions to discuss Buddhism together.

sentences.zh: 佛教強調同體與共生的理念，提醒我們在生活中要以慈悲待人。
sentences.en: Buddhism emphasizes the concept of oneness and coexistence, reminding us to treat others with compassion in our lives.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會議中，與會者討論如何促進全球的同體與共生。
sentences.en: During the conference of the BLIA, participants discussed how to promote global oneness and coexistence.

sentences.zh: BLIA的成員們相信，透過互助合作可以實現更好的同體與共生。
sentences.en: The members of the BLIA believe that through mutual assistance and cooperation, better oneness and coexistence can be achieved.

sentences.zh: 在教育課程中，我們學習了如何在多元文化中實現同體與共生。
sentences.en: In the educational program, we learned how to achieve oneness and coexistence within a multicultural society.

phrase.zh: 國定佛誕節暨母親節慶祝大會
phrase.en: National Buddha’s Day and Mother’s Day Celebration

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會今年將於寺院舉行盛大的國定佛誕節暨母親節慶祝大會。
sentences.en: The International Buddha’s Light Association will host a grand National Buddha’s Day and Mother’s Day Celebration at the temple this year.

sentences.zh: 許多信徒和家庭都會出席國定佛誕節暨母親節慶祝大會，以表達對佛陀和母親的崇敬和感謝。
sentences.en: Many devotees and families will attend the National Buddha’s Day and Mother’s Day Celebration to express their reverence and gratitude to Buddha and mothers.

sentences.zh: 慶祝大會將包括佛教經典誦經、獻花儀式以及對母親的祈福活動。
sentences.en: The celebration will include Buddhist scripture chanting, a flower offering ceremony, and blessing activities for mothers.

sentences.zh: 在國定佛誕節暨母親節慶祝大會中，主席強調母親如同佛陀般重要，是無私愛的象徵。
sentences.en: During the National Buddha’s Day and Mother’s Day Celebration, the chairperson emphasized that mothers are as important as Buddha and are symbols of selfless love.

phrase.en: National Buddha’s Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會舉辦了一場盛大的國定佛誕節浴佛大會，吸引了來自全國各地的信眾。
sentences.en: The BLIA organized a grand National Buddha’s Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration, attracting devotees from all over the country.

sentences.zh: 在國定佛誕節浴佛大會中，大家誠心以清水浴佛，表達敬意。
sentences.en: During the National Buddha’s Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration, everyone sincerely bathed the Buddha with pure water as a sign of respect.

sentences.zh: 參加國定佛誕節浴佛大會讓我感受到與佛法的更深連結。
sentences.en: Participating in the National Buddha’s Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration gave me a deeper connection with the teachings of Buddha.

sentences.zh: 每年的國定佛誕節浴佛大會都是佛教徒表達虔誠信仰的重要時刻。
sentences.en: The annual National Buddha’s Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration is an important occasion for Buddhists to express their devout faith.

sentences.zh: 每年的國際佛光日，世界各地的信徒齊聚一堂，慶祝佛陀的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: On International Buddha’s Light Day each year, devotees from around the world gather to celebrate the wisdom and compassion of Buddha.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光日是與家人和朋友分享快樂與和平的日子。
sentences.en: International Buddha’s Light Day is a day to share joy and peace with family and friends.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光日，許多城市舉行大型的祈願法會，吸引了數以千計的信眾參與。
sentences.en: On International Buddha’s Light Day, many cities hold grand prayer services that attract thousands of participants.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會長在國際佛光日發表演講，呼籲大家共同努力實現全球和平。
sentences.en: The President of the BLIA delivered a speech on International Buddha’s Light Day, urging everyone to work together for global peace.

sentences.zh: 每年，國際佛光會世界大會吸引來自世界各地的會長與幹部齊聚一堂，共同討論未來的方針。
sentences.en: Each year, the BLIA World Headquarters General Conference attracts presidents and officials from around the world to come together and discuss future directives.

sentences.zh: 在今年的國際佛光會世界大會上，與會者分享了許多關於宗教教育的新見解。
sentences.en: At this year's BLIA World Headquarters General Conference, participants shared many new insights about religious education.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界大會強調全球佛教徒攜手合作，促進世界和平的共同目標。
sentences.en: The BLIA World Headquarters General Conference emphasizes the shared goal of promoting world peace through the cooperation of global Buddhists.

sentences.zh: 這次國際佛光會世界大會的主題是『協調與發展』，旨在加強世界各地分會的協作關係。
sentences.en: The theme of this BLIA World Headquarters General Conference was 'Coordination and Development', aiming to strengthen collaborative relationships among branches worldwide.

phrase.en: Buddha’s Light International Association World Headquarters (BLIA World Headquarters)

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會在佛教界中扮演著重要的角色，推動全球的佛教交流與合作。
sentences.en: The BLIA World Headquarters plays a vital role in the Buddhist community, promoting global Buddhist exchange and cooperation.

sentences.zh: 她被任命為國際佛光會世界總會的會長，負責整體的運營和未來發展方向。
sentences.en: She was appointed as the President of the BLIA World Headquarters, responsible for overall operations and the strategic development direction.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會的理事會每年定期召開會議，檢討並規劃來年的活動。
sentences.en: The BLIA World Headquarters Council holds regular meetings annually to review and plan activities for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 作為國際佛光會世界總會的一員，他深感自豪並致力於佛教文化的弘揚。
sentences.en: As a member of the BLIA World Headquarters, he is proud and committed to promoting Buddhist culture.

phrase.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會每年吸引來自世界各地的成員參加。
sentences.en: The BLIA General Conference annually attracts members from around the world to participate.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會上，討論了未來一年的計劃和策略。
sentences.en: During the BLIA General Conference, plans and strategies for the upcoming year were discussed.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會提供了一個分享和交流經驗的平台。
sentences.en: The BLIA General Conference provided a platform for sharing and exchanging experiences.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會結束後，與會者紛紛表示受益良多。
sentences.en: After the BLIA General Conference, participants expressed how much they benefited from the event.

phrase.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會理事會議
phrase.en: BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會理事會議每年舉行一次，以檢討和制定組織的長期發展計劃。
sentences.en: The BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting is held annually to review and formulate long-term development plans for the organization.

sentences.zh: 在本次國際佛光會世界總會理事會議中，理事們討論了有關增強全球宗教對話的策略。
sentences.en: During this year's BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting, the directors discussed strategies for enhancing global interfaith dialogue.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會主席在世界總會理事會議上強調了青年參與佛光會活動的重要性。
sentences.en: The president of BLIA emphasized the importance of youth participation in BLIA activities during the World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting.

sentences.zh: 許多來自全球不同分會的成員參加了國際佛光會世界總會理事會議，以分享成功經驗。
sentences.en: Many members from various global chapters attended the BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting to share their successful experiences.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會中華總會日前成功舉辦了一場大型的慈善募款活動。
sentences.en: The BLIA Chunghua Headquarters recently successfully organized a large-scale charity fundraising event.

sentences.zh: 她將在國際佛光會中華總會擔任會長，負責帶領該組織的各項活動。
sentences.en: She will serve as the president at the BLIA Chunghua Headquarters, responsible for leading various organizational activities.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會中華總會積極推動各地分會的互動與合作。
sentences.en: The BLIA Chunghua Headquarters actively promotes interaction and cooperation among its local chapters.

sentences.zh: 他收到了來自國際佛光會中華總會的榮譽會員證書，表彰其對佛教文化的貢獻。
sentences.en: He received an honorary membership certificate from the BLIA Chunghua Headquarters, recognizing his contributions to Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會日，成員們聚集在一起，慶祝他們的慈善成就和文化交流。
sentences.en: On Buddha's Light Day, members gather to celebrate their charitable achievements and cultural exchanges.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會日在佛光山寺舉行盛大的慶典活動，吸引了來自世界各地的信眾。
sentences.en: A grand celebration is held at Fo Guang Shan Monastery on Buddha’s Light Day, attracting devotees from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會日是促進和平與和諧的象徵，這一天全球的佛教徒一同祈願世界和平。
sentences.en: Buddha’s Light Day symbolizes the promotion of peace and harmony, and on this day, Buddhists worldwide pray for global peace.

sentences.zh: 每年的國際佛光會日都由國際佛光會的理事會精心籌劃，確保活動順利進行。
sentences.en: Each year, Buddha’s Light Day is carefully organized by the BLIA Council to ensure the smooth running of events.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會會徽象徵著佛光普照大地的精神。
sentences.en: The BLIA logo symbolizes the spirit of the Buddha's light illuminating the world.

sentences.zh: 在每次國際大會中，國際佛光會會徽都會被高高懸掛，代表著團結與和諧。
sentences.en: At each international conference, the BLIA logo is prominently displayed, representing unity and harmony.

sentences.zh: 新成員們被首次帶領參觀國際佛光會，特別是了解會徽的設計與理念。
sentences.en: New members are first introduced to the BLIA by learning about the design and philosophy of the logo.

sentences.zh: 在宣傳材料中，國際佛光會會徽被用來強調組織的願景和使命。
sentences.en: In promotional materials, the BLIA logo is used to emphasize the organization's vision and mission.

sentences.zh: 在大型法會上，國際佛光會會旗高高飄揚，象徵著佛光的普照無遠弗屆。
sentences.en: At the grand Dharma assembly, the BLIA flag flies high, symbolizing the boundless reach of Buddha's light.

sentences.zh: 每年會員大會時，所有分會都會驕傲地展示國際佛光會會旗。
sentences.en: During the annual general meeting, all chapters proudly display the BLIA flag.

sentences.zh: 設計國際佛光會會旗的初衷是為了展現慈悲與智慧的結合。
sentences.en: The design of the BLIA flag was intended to represent the union of compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會會旗的顏色和圖案都有其特定的佛教象徵意義。
sentences.en: The colors and patterns of the BLIA flag hold specific Buddhist symbolic meanings.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會會歌每月出版一次，帶來佛光人的最新消息和活動報告。
sentences.en: The Buddha’s Light Newsletter is published monthly, bringing the latest news and event reports to the BLIA members.

sentences.zh: 許多人期待收到國際佛光會會歌的最新一期，了解全球各地分會的動態。
sentences.en: Many people eagerly await the latest edition of the Buddha’s Light Newsletter to learn about the activities of chapters worldwide.

sentences.zh: 新的國際佛光會會歌已經發行，上面刊登了多位青年成員的傑出貢獻。
sentences.en: The new edition of the Buddha’s Light Newsletter has been published, showcasing the outstanding contributions of several young members.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會會歌的編輯團隊努力確保每一期內容的多樣性和深度。
sentences.en: The editorial team of the Buddha’s Light Newsletter strives to ensure each issue's diversity and depth of content.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會檀講師受邀主持這次的修行講座，他的演講讓與會者受益良多。
sentences.en: The BLIA Lay Dharma Lecturer was invited to host this practice seminar, and his speech greatly benefited the attendees.

sentences.zh: 她作為國際佛光會檀講師，經常在各地進行佛學講座，宣揚佛法智慧。
sentences.en: As a BLIA Lay Dharma Lecturer, she frequently conducts Dharma lectures in various places, promoting the wisdom of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會檀講師在這次活動中分享了有關慈悲和智慧相結合的深刻見解。
sentences.en: The BLIA Lay Dharma Lecturer shared profound insights on the integration of compassion and wisdom during this event.

sentences.zh: 為了提升佛法的傳播效果，國際佛光會特設了檀講師進修課程。
sentences.en: To enhance the effectiveness of disseminating Dharma, the BLIA has established advanced training courses for Lay Dharma Lecturers.

phrase.en: Buddha’s Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD)

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會青年總團每年都會舉辦全球青年聯誼會，促進不同文化間的交流與學習。
sentences.en: The Buddha’s Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD) hosts an annual global youth conference to promote cross-cultural exchange and learning.

sentences.zh: 作為國際佛光會青年總團的積極成員，她積極參與社區服務活動，從中獲得了不少寶貴的經驗。
sentences.en: As an active member of the Buddha’s Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD), she actively participates in community service projects, gaining a wealth of valuable experience.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會青年總團的使命是培養新一代的佛教領袖，激勵他們用智慧與慈悲影響世界。
sentences.en: The mission of the Buddha’s Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD) is to cultivate the next generation of Buddhist leaders, inspiring them to influence the world with wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會青年總團的會員們來自世界各地，共同致力於弘揚佛法與推動人間佛教。
sentences.en: Members of the Buddha’s Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD) come from all around the world, united in their commitment to spreading the Dharma and promoting Humanistic Buddhism.

phrase.en: International Buddha’s Light BLIA Young Adult Conference

sentences.zh: 國際佛光青年會議於今年吸引了來自世界各地的年輕人參加，他們共同探討佛教在現代社會的作用。
sentences.en: The International Buddha’s Light BLIA Young Adult Conference this year attracted young people from around the world to discuss the role of Buddhism in modern society.

sentences.zh: 作為國際佛光會的活動之一，國際佛光青年會議促進了成員之間的文化交流與思想的深化。
sentences.en: As one of the activities of the Buddha's Light International Association, the International Buddha’s Light BLIA Young Adult Conference facilitated cultural exchange and deepening of ideas among its members.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光青年會議上，多位講者強調了青年人在推動全球和諧中的重要性。
sentences.en: At the International Buddha’s Light BLIA Young Adult Conference, several speakers emphasized the importance of youth in promoting global harmony.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光青年會議的討論覆蓋了如何在日常生活中實踐佛法的多個領域。
sentences.en: The discussions at the International Buddha’s Light BLIA Young Adult Conference covered various aspects of practicing Dharma in daily life.

sentences.zh: 在佛教信仰中，圓滿與自在的境界是每個修行者所追求的目標。
sentences.en: In Buddhist belief, the state of wholeness and freeness is the goal every practitioner strives to attain.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的主席強調了生活中保持圓滿與自在的重要性。
sentences.en: The president of BLIA emphasized the importance of maintaining wholeness and freeness in life.

sentences.zh: 她在禪修中找到了內心的圓滿與自在。
sentences.en: She found inner wholeness and freeness through meditation.

sentences.zh: 理事會討論如何在工作環境中創造圓滿與自在的氛圍。
sentences.en: The council discussed how to create an atmosphere of wholeness and freeness in the workplace.

sentences.zh: 今年的國際佛光會大洋洲聯誼會將在悉尼舉行，吸引了來自各地的會員參加。
sentences.en: This year's BLIA Oceania Fellowship Meeting will be held in Sydney, attracting members from various regions.

sentences.zh: 在大洋洲聯誼會上，會員們分享了他們在弘揚佛教文化方面的成功經驗。
sentences.en: At the BLIA Oceania Fellowship Meeting, members shared their successful experiences in promoting Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 大洋洲聯誼會提供了一個良好的平臺，讓會員們能夠交流想法並擴展友誼。
sentences.en: The BLIA Oceania Fellowship Meeting provides an excellent platform for members to exchange ideas and expand friendships.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的理事會在大洋洲聯誼會上選出了新一屆的地區會長。
sentences.en: The BLIA council elected a new regional president at the Oceania Fellowship Meeting.

sentences.zh: 天馬幹部在國際佛光會聚會中提出了一個具創意且實用的計劃。
sentences.en: The Pegasus Executive presented a creative and practical plan at the BLIA meeting.

sentences.zh: 作為天馬幹部，他負責組織國際佛光會的年度慶典。
sentences.en: As a Pegasus Executive, he is responsible for organizing the annual celebration of the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 天馬幹部們通常需要通曉多種文化，以便更好地開展工作。
sentences.en: Pegasus Executives often need to be well-versed in multiple cultures to better perform their duties.

sentences.zh: 新任的天馬幹部對國際佛光會的未來發展提出了許多新穎的見解。
sentences.en: The newly appointed Pegasus Executive offered many novel insights into the future development of the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的成員們在會議中強調尊重與包容，以促進和諧與團結。
sentences.en: Members of the BLIA emphasized respect and tolerance during the meeting to promote harmony and unity.

sentences.zh: 在多元文化的團體中，尊重與包容是建立信任的基石。
sentences.en: In a multicultural group, respect and tolerance are the cornerstones for building trust.

sentences.zh: 佛光會期待藉由推廣尊重與包容的精神，來改善社會的摩擦與隔閡。
sentences.en: The BLIA aims to alleviate social frictions and gaps by promoting the spirit of respect and tolerance.

sentences.zh: 他在行政文書組的工作中時常運用尊重與包容，確保同事之間的良好合作。
sentences.en: He often applies respect and tolerance in his work within the administrative documentation group to ensure effective collaboration among colleagues.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會致力於推動全球的平等與和平，促進人類的共同福祉。
sentences.en: The BLIA is dedicated to promoting global peace and equality, fostering the common welfare of humanity.

sentences.zh: 該會長在演講中強調了平等與和平的重要性，呼籲大家攜手合作，共同創造美好的未來。
sentences.en: The president emphasized the importance of peace and equality in his speech, urging everyone to work together for a brighter future.

sentences.zh: 新成立的行政文書組將專注於平等與和平相關政策的制定與推廣。
sentences.en: The newly formed Administrative Documentation Unit will focus on the formulation and promotion of policies related to peace and equality.

sentences.zh: 這本書探討了佛教如何透過智慧與慈悲來推動平等與和平。
sentences.en: This book explores how Buddhism uses wisdom and compassion to promote peace and equality.

sentences.zh: 參加國際佛光會的活動能讓人感受到幸福與安樂。
sentences.en: Attending activities of the Buddha's Light International Association brings a sense of happiness and peace.

sentences.zh: 會長在演講中闡述了追求幸福與安樂的方法。
sentences.en: The president elaborated on the methods of pursuing happiness and peace in their speech.

sentences.zh: 理事會討論了如何促進社區的幸福與安樂。
sentences.en: The council discussed how to promote happiness and peace in the community.

sentences.zh: 在每日的禪修中尋找內心的幸福與安樂。
sentences.en: Find inner happiness and peace during daily meditation.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的幹部講習會每年吸引眾多社會精英參加，分享管理和領導力經驗。
sentences.en: The Leadership Training Seminar of the BLIA attracts numerous social elites each year to share experiences in management and leadership.

sentences.zh: 在幹部講習會上，會長深入剖析了未來的發展方向和策略。
sentences.en: At the Leadership Training Seminar, the president provided an in-depth analysis of future development directions and strategies.

sentences.zh: 這次的幹部講習會重點討論了如何有效促進會員的合作與協調。
sentences.en: This Leadership Training Seminar focused on effective methods to promote cooperation and coordination among members.

sentences.zh: 幹部講習會提供各地分會的領導幹部一個學習和交流的平台。
sentences.en: The Leadership Training Seminar offers a platform for the leadership officers from various chapters to learn and exchange ideas.

sentences.zh: 今年的復蔬線上公益路跑吸引了數千名來自全球各地的參與者。
sentences.en: This year's VEGRUN attracted thousands of participants from around the world.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會長致辭時讚揚了復蔬線上公益路跑的慈善精神。
sentences.en: The president of BLIA praised the charitable spirit of the VEGRUN in her speech.

sentences.zh: 通過參加復蔬線上公益路跑，我們可以推廣健康生活與素食的理念。
sentences.en: By participating in the VEGRUN, we can promote healthy living and the concept of vegetarianism.

sentences.zh: 復蔬線上公益路跑的資金將用於支持國際佛光會的慈善計畫。
sentences.en: The funds from the VEGRUN will be used to support BLIA's charitable projects.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會的年度大會上，他以智慧與創新提出了應對全球挑戰的新策略。
sentences.en: At the annual conference of BLIA, he presented new strategies to tackle global challenges through wisdom and innovation.

sentences.zh: 智慧與創新是佛光山推動未來發展的兩大支柱。
sentences.en: Wisdom and innovation are the two main pillars that propel the future development of Fo Guang Shan.

sentences.zh: 年輕的會長強調智慧與創新是打造更和諧美好社會的關鍵。
sentences.en: The young chairman emphasized that wisdom and innovation are key to building a more harmonious and better society.

sentences.zh: 透過智慧與創新的結合，國際佛光會行政文書組提升了工作效率。
sentences.en: Through the combination of wisdom and innovation, the BLIA's administrative documentation team has improved work efficiency.

sentences.zh: 這個項目由國際佛光會主席啟動，旨在為年輕人帶來未來與希望。
sentences.en: The project was launched by the President of BLIA to bring future and hope to the youth.

sentences.zh: 未來與希望是國際佛光會理事會的核心價值觀，他們致力於支持社區發展。
sentences.en: Future and hope are core values of the BLIA Board of Directors, who are dedicated to supporting community development.

sentences.zh: 在這次會議中，講者們討論了如何通過教育來實現更好的未來與希望。
sentences.en: In this conference, speakers discussed how to achieve a better future and hope through education.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會行政文書組正在籌備一場活動，主題是“為未來與希望而努力”。
sentences.en: The BLIA Administrative Affairs Department is organizing an event themed 'Striving for Future and Hope'.

sentences.zh: 檀教師在佛光山的年度法會上分享了他在修行路上的心得。
sentences.en: The Lay Dharma Lecturer shared his insights from the path of practice at the annual dharma assembly at Fo Guang Shan.

sentences.zh: 作為一名檀教師，她致力於將佛法的智慧帶入日常生活中。
sentences.en: As a Lay Dharma Lecturer, she is dedicated to bringing the wisdom of the Dharma into daily life.

sentences.zh: 這位檀教師被邀請到國際佛光會(BLIA)的理事會發表主題演講。
sentences.en: The Lay Dharma Lecturer was invited to the board of the Buddha's Light International Association (BLIA) to give a keynote speech.

sentences.zh: 他在擔任檀教師多年後，成為了許多信眾的精神導師。
sentences.en: After serving as a Lay Dharma Lecturer for many years, he became a spiritual mentor to many followers.

sentences.zh: 檀講師的課程深受佛學愛好者的歡迎，每次上課都座無虛席。
sentences.en: The Lay Dharma Teacher's classes are very popular among Buddhist enthusiasts, with every session fully attended.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的檀講師們每月定期為信眾開示佛法，傳播智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: The Lay Dharma Teachers of the International Buddhist Light Association regularly offer monthly Dharma talks to disseminate wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 成為一名檀講師需要不斷的學習與修持，以便更好地教導他人。
sentences.en: Becoming a Lay Dharma Teacher requires continuous learning and practice to better guide others.

sentences.zh: 她被任命為國際佛光會的檀講師，負責社區內的佛學課程和禪修活動。
sentences.en: She was appointed as a Lay Dharma Teacher for the International Buddhist Light Association, responsible for Buddhist classes and meditation activities within the community.

sentences.zh: 歐洲佛光幹部講習會每年舉辦一次，旨在加強各分會之間的合作與交流。
sentences.en: The BLIA Europe Executive Seminar is held annually to strengthen cooperation and communication among the chapters.

sentences.zh: 此屆歐洲佛光幹部講習會的主題是『和諧共融，創新未來』。
sentences.en: This year's BLIA Europe Executive Seminar theme is 'Harmony and Innovation for the Future'.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會主席親自參加了歐洲佛光幹部講習會並發表了開幕演講。
sentences.en: The President of BLIA personally attended the BLIA Europe Executive Seminar and delivered the opening speech.

sentences.zh: 在歐洲佛光幹部講習會中，幹部們探討了如何推動佛法在現代社會中的應用。
sentences.en: During the BLIA Europe Executive Seminar, executives discussed how to promote the application of Buddhism in modern society.

sentences.zh: 在佛光山舉行的年度法會上，所有的參與者都感受到滿滿的歡喜與融和。
sentences.en: At the annual Dharma assembly held at Fo Guang Shan, all participants felt an overwhelming sense of joy and harmony.

sentences.zh: 我們的目的在於創建一個充滿歡喜與融和的社區，在這裡每個人都能夠感受到包容與關愛。
sentences.en: Our goal is to create a community filled with joy and harmony, where everyone can feel included and loved.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會的年度理事會上，會長強調了歡喜與融和對於全球和諧的重要性。
sentences.en: At the annual board meeting of BLIA, the President emphasized the importance of joy and harmony for global peace.

sentences.zh: 她在國際佛光會志工服務中，時刻展現出歡喜與融和的精神，成為新志工的榜樣。
sentences.en: In her volunteer work with BLIA, she constantly exemplifies the spirit of joy and harmony, serving as a role model for new volunteers.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會長強調環保與心保同等重要，每位成員都應該關心地球健康與內心平和。
sentences.en: The President of BLIA emphasized that environmental and spiritual preservation are equally important, and every member should care for the health of the earth and peace of mind.

sentences.zh: 在週末的論壇上，與會者討論了如何將環保與心保融入日常生活中。
sentences.en: At the weekend's forum, participants discussed how to integrate environmental and spiritual preservation into their daily lives.

sentences.zh: 此次會議由國際佛光會理事會組織，旨在提升公眾對環保與心保的意識。
sentences.en: This conference, organized by the BLIA board of directors, aims to raise public awareness on environmental and spiritual preservation.

sentences.zh: 行政文書組正在籌劃一系列活動，以促進環保與心保的教育和實踐。
sentences.en: The administrative paperwork unit is organizing a series of activities to promote education and practice of environmental and spiritual preservation.

sentences.zh: 作為國際佛光會的當然代表，他持續參與國際會議，促進文化交流。
sentences.en: As the ex-officio delegate of BLIA, he continuously participates in international conferences to promote cultural exchange.

sentences.zh: 行政文書組的當然代表負責紀錄所有重要會議的決議。
sentences.en: The ex-officio delegate of the Administrative Documentation Unit is responsible for recording all important resolutions from the meetings.

sentences.zh: 這位資深成員成為理事會的當然代表，協助推動組織成長。
sentences.en: The senior member became the ex-officio delegate of the council, assisting in driving organizational growth.

sentences.zh: 她被任命為年度大會的當然代表，代表組織傳達年度目標。
sentences.en: She was appointed as the ex-officio delegate for the annual convention, representing the organization to convey the yearly objectives.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會員們共同發心與發展這項新計劃，旨在提升社會福祉。
sentences.en: The members of the BLIA resolved and developed this new project together, aiming to enhance social welfare.

sentences.zh: 作為國際佛光會的會長，他的領導風格強調發心與發展，帶領組織走向成功。
sentences.en: As the president of the BLIA, his leadership style emphasizes to resolve and to develop, steering the organization towards success.

sentences.zh: 這支年輕的團隊在國際佛光會的支持下，發心與發展了一個創新的社區服務計劃。
sentences.en: With the support of the BLIA, this young team resolved and developed an innovative community service program.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的理事會提出發心與發展的策略，帶動了整個組織的變革。
sentences.en: The board of directors of the BLIA proposed a strategy to resolve and to develop, driving transformation throughout the organization.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會的會議上，白象幹部提出了一項新的企劃，旨在促進全球成員的交流與合作。
sentences.en: At the BLIA meeting, the White Elephant Executive proposed a new initiative aimed at enhancing global member interaction and cooperation.

sentences.zh: 作為白象幹部，他負責監督國際佛光會的重要活動，以確保所有的安排都是依計劃進行的。
sentences.en: As a White Elephant Executive, he is responsible for overseeing key events of the BLIA to ensure all arrangements are on schedule.

sentences.zh: 白象幹部的年度報告詳述了過去一年內國際佛光會的成就和未來的展望。
sentences.en: The annual report by the White Elephant Executive detailed the achievements of the BLIA over the past year and its future outlook.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的白象幹部小組正在研究如何更好地推廣佛教文化。
sentences.en: The White Elephant Executive team at the BLIA is researching new ways to better promote Buddhist culture.

phrase.zh: 禪淨共修獻燈祈福法會
phrase.en: Chan and Pure Land Prayer Service

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會員們共同參加禪淨共修獻燈祈福法會，為世界和平祈禱。
sentences.en: Members of BLIA participated in the Chan and Pure Land Prayer Service to pray for world peace.

sentences.zh: 這次禪淨共修獻燈祈福法會吸引了不同信仰背景的人們共襄盛舉。
sentences.en: The Chan and Pure Land Prayer Service attracted people from diverse faith backgrounds to partake in the event.

sentences.zh: 禪淨共修獻燈祈福法會由國際佛光會理事會主席主持。
sentences.en: The Chan and Pure Land Prayer Service was led by the Chairman of the BLIA Board of Directors.

sentences.zh: 此次禪淨共修獻燈祈福法會旨在培養大家內心的平靜和慈悲心。
sentences.en: This Chan and Pure Land Prayer Service aimed to cultivate inner peace and compassion among participants.

phrase.zh: 禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會
phrase.en: Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會每年都會舉辦禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會，以促進參加者的內心平和和精神啟迪。
sentences.en: The International Buddha's Light Association hosts the Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony annually to promote inner peace and spiritual enlightenment among participants.

sentences.zh: 許多信眾參加了今年的禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會，祈願世界和平和人類幸福。
sentences.en: Many devotees attended this year's Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony, praying for world peace and the happiness of all beings.

sentences.zh: 在禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會中，參加者點燃燈火象徵心靈的覺醒與清淨。
sentences.en: During the Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony, participants light lamps symbolizing the awakening and purification of the mind.

sentences.zh: 禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會結束後，大家感受到一種深刻的內心寧靜與和諧。
sentences.en: After the Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony concluded, everyone felt a profound sense of inner tranquility and harmony.

sentences.zh: 禪與生活的關聯性在於融入日常體驗，不斷自省與提升心靈境界。
sentences.en: The connection between Chan and life lies in integrating daily experiences, with continual self-reflection and elevation of the spiritual realm.

sentences.zh: 經過多年的修行，他理解了禪與生活的深邃意義，並將其應用到會長的工作中。
sentences.en: After years of practice, he grasped the profound meaning of Chan and life and applied it to his role as the president.

sentences.zh: 她在禪修課程中學習如何將禪與生活結合，從而改善自己的心態和行為。
sentences.en: She learned how to integrate Chan and life in her meditation course, improving her mindset and behavior.

sentences.zh: 除了理事會的責任，他也推廣禪與生活的理念，鼓勵更多人參加禪修活動。
sentences.en: Aside from his duties on the council, he also promotes the concept of Chan and life, encouraging more people to join meditation activities.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會大會上，總會長發表了鼓舞人心的演講，引領大家共同努力。
sentences.en: At the BLIA conference, the President delivered an inspiring speech, leading everyone to work together.

sentences.zh: 總會長每年都會主持國際佛光會的年度大會，與全球會員分享未來的發展規劃。
sentences.en: The President hosts the annual BLIA World HQ meeting each year, sharing future development plans with members around the world.

sentences.zh: 總會長強調各地分會之間的合作與交流，以促進國際佛光會的全球影響力。
sentences.en: The President emphasized the importance of cooperation and exchange among regional chapters to enhance the global influence of BLIA.

sentences.zh: 在總會長的領導下，國際佛光會在全球各地成立了多個新的分會，擴展了其慈善事業。
sentences.en: Under the leadership of the President, the BLIA World HQ has established several new chapters worldwide, expanding its charitable initiatives.

sentences.zh: 在正式會長出國期間，署理會長負責主持國際佛光會的各項事務。
sentences.en: During the official president's absence abroad, the Acting President (BLIA World HQ) is responsible for overseeing all affairs of the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 對於即將到來的年會，署理會長正積極準備相關計劃與安排。
sentences.en: The Acting President (BLIA World HQ) is actively preparing plans and arrangements for the upcoming annual meeting.

sentences.zh: 在緊急情況下，署理會長有權代表會長做出重要決策。
sentences.en: In emergencies, the Acting President (BLIA World HQ) is authorized to make critical decisions on behalf of the president.

sentences.zh: 署理會長表示，他將不遺餘力地推動佛光會的全球推廣工作。
sentences.en: The Acting President (BLIA World HQ) stated that he will spare no effort in promoting the global outreach of the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 他們致力於研究自然與生命的相互關係，以增強人類對環境保護的責任感。
sentences.en: They are committed to studying the interconnectedness of nature and life to enhance human responsibility for environmental protection.

sentences.zh: 在這次國際佛光會的會議中，主席強調了自然與生命的重要性，呼籲成員們重視環保。
sentences.en: During this BLIA meeting, the chairperson emphasized the importance of nature and life, urging members to prioritize environmental preservation.

sentences.zh: 那位有名的生態學家在演講中探討了自然與生命的深刻聯繫，引發了聽眾的深思。
sentences.en: The renowned ecologist explored the profound connection between nature and life in her lecture, provoking deep reflection among the audience.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒常常通過冥想來感受自然與生命的和諧，以培養內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Buddhists often use meditation to experience the harmony of nature and life, cultivating inner peace.

phrase.en: Self-awareness and Practicing the Buddha’s Way

sentences.zh: 在他的修行過程中，自覺與行佛是他每日反思的重要課題。
sentences.en: In his practice, self-awareness and practicing the Buddha’s way are essential subjects for his daily reflection.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會長鼓勵會員們將自覺與行佛融入他們的日常生活。
sentences.en: The President of BLIA encourages members to integrate self-awareness and practicing the Buddha’s way into their daily lives.

sentences.zh: 她在禪修課程中學習如何透過自覺與行佛來提升自己的心靈境界。
sentences.en: During the meditation class, she learned how to elevate her spiritual state through self-awareness and practicing the Buddha’s way.

sentences.zh: 在理事會的討論中，大家一致認為提升自覺與行佛的能力對建立和諧社群至關重要。
sentences.en: During the council meeting, everyone agreed that enhancing self-awareness and practicing the Buddha’s way is crucial for building a harmonious community.

sentences.zh: 這對菩提眷屬在國際佛光會的每一次慈善活動中都攜手合作。
sentences.en: This bodhi couple always works hand in hand during every charity event of the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 他們作為菩提眷屬，以智慧和慈悲影響著整個社區。
sentences.en: As a bodhi couple, they influence the entire community with their wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的會長讚美這對菩提眷屬在弘揚佛法方面的非凡貢獻。
sentences.en: The president of the BLIA praised this bodhi couple for their extraordinary contributions in promoting Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這對菩提眷屬希望以他們的行動啟發更多人追隨正道。
sentences.en: This bodhi couple hopes to inspire more people to follow the righteous path through their actions.

sentences.zh: 在佛教禪修中，菩提種子象徵著我們心中的智慧和覺悟。
sentences.en: In Buddhist meditation, bodhi seeds symbolize the wisdom and enlightenment within our hearts.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的成員在佛學課程中學習如何種下菩提種子，開啟心靈的成長。
sentences.en: Members of the BLIA study how to plant bodhi seeds in Buddhist courses, initiating the growth of the soul.

sentences.zh: 那位大師經常提到，菩提種子需要我們持續的信念與努力才能發芽。
sentences.en: The master often mentions that bodhi seeds require continuous faith and effort to sprout.

sentences.zh: 我們可以把慈悲和智慧比作種植內在菩提種子的土壤。
sentences.en: We can compare compassion and wisdom to the soil for planting the inner bodhi seeds.

sentences.zh: 他像菩薩一樣慈悲為懷，總是義務幫助那些需要幫助的人。
sentences.en: He, like a Bodhisattva, is full of compassion and always volunteers to help those in need.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒們常常說，行善如同菩薩精神，讓眾人成為義工。
sentences.en: Buddhists often say that doing good is akin to the spirit of a Bodhisattva, inspiring many to become volunteers.

sentences.zh: 她在國際佛光會擔任義工，同時也努力修行菩薩道。
sentences.en: She serves as a volunteer in the BLIA while also diligently practicing the Bodhisattva path.

sentences.zh: 在那次災難後，義工們展現出菩薩般無私的愛，提供無盡的支持與關懷。
sentences.en: After the disaster, the volunteers demonstrated selfless love like that of Bodhisattvas, providing endless support and care.

sentences.zh: 蔬食A計畫是由國際佛光會的綠色生活組主導的環保倡議。
sentences.en: Vege Plan A is an environmental initiative led by the Green Living Group of the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 該活動旨在推廣無肉飲食，以減少碳足跡，蔬食A計畫因此獲得了高度讚揚。
sentences.en: The event aims to promote a meat-free diet to reduce the carbon footprint, and Vege Plan A has been highly praised for this effort.

sentences.zh: 參加蔬食A計畫的成員每週至少有三天遵循純素食飲食。
sentences.en: Members participating in Vege Plan A follow a vegan diet at least three days a week.

sentences.zh: 蔬食A計畫的成功啟發了許多其他社區採取類似的環保措施。
sentences.en: The success of Vege Plan A has inspired many other communities to adopt similar eco-friendly measures.

sentences.zh: 在理事會會議上，觀察員提供了重要的意見，幫助解決了許多問題。
sentences.en: During the council meeting, the observer provided valuable insights that helped resolve many issues.

sentences.zh: 作為一名觀察員，他的工作是記錄會議中的重要細節，並向上級報告。
sentences.en: As an observer, his job is to record important details at the meeting and report them to the superiors.

sentences.zh: 新加入的觀察員在行政文書組找到了很多學習的機會。
sentences.en: The newly joined observer found many learning opportunities in the Administration and Documentation Department.

sentences.zh: 由於他長期擔任觀察員，已經對佛光山的運作流程相當熟悉。
sentences.en: Having served as an observer for a long time, he has become quite familiar with the operation processes of the Fo Guang Shan.

phrase.en: Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Facilitator’s Training Seminar

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會正在舉辦一場讀書會帶領人講習會，以培訓成員成為更有效的組織者。
sentences.en: The BLIA is hosting a Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Facilitator’s Training Seminar to train members to become more effective organizers.

sentences.zh: 參加讀書會帶領人講習會的志工對於如何促進小組討論有了更深入的了解。
sentences.en: Volunteers attending the Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Facilitator’s Training Seminar gained deeper insights into facilitating group discussions.

sentences.zh: 這場讀書會帶領人講習會由國際佛光會主席主持，吸引了來自各地的學員。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Facilitator’s Training Seminar was led by the BLIA President and attracted participants from various regions.

sentences.zh: 通過讀書會帶領人講習會，參與者能夠學習到人間佛教的核心價值和精神。
sentences.en: Through the Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group Facilitator’s Training Seminar, participants learned the core values and spirit of Humanistic Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 金剛居士們在佛光山參與了今年的禪修營，感受到了內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The Buddha’s Light Men participated in this year's meditation retreat at Fo Guang Shan and felt a deep sense of peace.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會的年會中，金剛居士扮演著重要的角色，協助會務運行。
sentences.en: At the BLIA annual meeting, the Buddha’s Light Men played a crucial role in assisting with the operations.

sentences.zh: 他們以金剛居士的身份，致力於推廣佛教文化與教育，將智慧帶給世人。
sentences.en: In their capacity as Buddha’s Light Men, they are dedicated to promoting Buddhist culture and education, bringing wisdom to the world.

sentences.zh: 金剛居士經常參與社區服務，成為社區的精神支柱。
sentences.en: The Buddha’s Light Men often participate in community service, becoming spiritual pillars of the community.

sentences.zh: 作為國際佛光會的金獅幹部，他負責組織年度慶典活動。
sentences.en: As a Golden Lion Executive of BLIA, he is responsible for organizing the annual celebration events.

sentences.zh: 金獅幹部們在理事會會議中討論了重要的政策變更。
sentences.en: The Golden Lion Executives discussed key policy changes during the council meeting.

sentences.zh: 這位金獅幹部以其領導能力和奉獻精神而聞名於國際佛光會。
sentences.en: This Golden Lion Executive is renowned in the BLIA for his leadership skills and dedication.

sentences.zh: 在成為金獅幹部之前，他曾擔任行政文書組的主要成員。
sentences.en: Before becoming a Golden Lion Executive, he was a key member of the administrative team in the BLIA.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會的預備檀講師研習吸引了來自各地的參與者，他們都希望提升自己的佛學知識。
sentences.en: The Preparatory Lay Dharma Lecturer Seminar organized by BLIA attracted participants from various regions, all eager to enhance their knowledge of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 在預備檀講師研習中，參與者們學習了如何以簡單易懂的方式傳播佛教教義。
sentences.en: During the Preparatory Lay Dharma Lecturer Seminar, participants learned how to convey Buddhist teachings in a simple and understandable manner.

sentences.zh: 佛光會理事會特別安排了一位資深法師在預備檀講師研習中教授三藏經典的基本概念。
sentences.en: The BLIA board specially arranged for an experienced Venerable to teach the basic concepts of the Tripitaka during the Preparatory Lay Dharma Lecturer Seminar.

sentences.zh: 完成預備檀講師研習的成員被勉勵繼續在佛光會中擔任積極的志工和教學者。
sentences.en: Members who completed the Preparatory Lay Dharma Lecturer Seminar were encouraged to continue serving as active volunteers and educators within BLIA.
